structures:
Use case: style-transfer. ONE cohesive production sprite sheet for Pixel Farm's buildings and working farm props. Reference 1 is the ACTUAL GAME SCREENSHOT, reference 2 its existing mint-green trees and reference 3 its simple small crop shapes. Match the calm pastel colors, coarse square pixels, broad flat forms and muted mauve/taupe outlines. Redesign the farmhouse into a proper cozy home (not a raised chicken shed), and make the chicken coop recognizable. Never copy Stardew Valley assets.
Output: transparent PNG, square, EXACT 3 columns by 3 rows of equally sized cells, isolated sprites with clear transparent gutters. No labels, text, watermark, painted background or baked checkerboard. Draw true low-resolution pixel art enlarged with nearest neighbor, NO anti-aliasing, no texture noise, no gradients, no realistic wooden grain. Only 2 shades per material, chunky shapes, muted sage roof tiles, cream plaster, warm pale timber, salmon accents. Orthographic 3/4 top-down view, consistent perspective and centered foot baseline. Building doors are FRONT-CENTER on the lowest front wall, accessible from the bottom.
ROW 1 left-to-right:
1. FARMHOUSE: friendly cream and warm timber cottage, muted sage pitched roof with a small chimney, two blue-gray windows, centered wooden door and two low entry steps, simple compact silhouette, about 56x60 logical pixels.
2. CHICKEN COOP: smaller squat warm wooden henhouse, sage roof, tiny centered chicken door and a short ramp, a single cream egg emblem carved over the door (no letters), about 40x38 logical pixels, same style.
3. GENERAL STORE: cream and timber village shop, simple sage roof, warm coral-and-cream striped small awning, two display windows and centered door, no text signs, about 68x60 logical pixels.
ROW 2:
1. COMMUNITY HALL: a wider cream town hall with sage gable roof, small round wooden clock high on facade, two windows and centered entrance, simple shapes, about 80x64 logical pixels.
2. WOOD CHEST CLOSED: simple warm timber chest with cream brass latch, perspective matching game, 24x20 logical pixels.
3. SAME WOOD CHEST OPEN: exact same body/base/perspective/size, hinged lid lifted, visible empty dark interior. Keep identical base to closed version.
ROW 3:
1. PRESERVES STATION IDLE: one squat pastel clay/glass jar with folded cream cloth lid and soft salmon contents, small wooden foot/base, 22x24 logical pixels.
2. SAME STATION WORKING: identical jar/body/base with gently raised lid and just two small cream bubbles above. No bright outline, no text.
3. SAME STATION READY: identical jar/body/base, neatly sealed cream lid with a small tied sage ribbon; a tiny cream star glint above indicates product finished. No text.
Each CELL has same 96x96 logical canvas; props are proportionally smaller than buildings, do not enlarge the chest or jars to fill the cell. Keep each subject fully inside its cell. Transparent outside silhouette. These must look simpler and less detailed than the current buildings, with no fussy shingles or black strokes.
furniture:
Use case: style-transfer. ONE coherent 24-piece farmhouse furniture sprite sheet for the existing Pixel Farm game. References: existing game's plants and simple crops establish the soft pastel, chunky pixels and flat shading; the two existing furniture examples are EDIT STYLE TARGETS to simplify, keeping recognizable object functions.
Create a transparent portrait sprite sheet EXACTLY 4 columns x 6 rows in regular equal square cells, 24 distinct isolated objects. No background, no baked checkerboard, no text, no labels, no gridlines. Logical cell 32x32 pixels, coarse square nearest-neighbor enlarged pixel shapes, soft taupe/mauve one-pixel outlines. Max 6-8 colors per object, warm light timber, cream cloth, sage green cushions, muted coral details. Two broad tones per material only. NO wood grain, no stippling, no dither, no detailed woven fabric, no sharp black borders, no perspective inconsistency. 3/4 top-down farm-game view, all furniture feet at same lower baseline within each row, ample gutters. Objects should feel like toys in the same world as the simple pixel carrots.
Exact row order left-to-right:
ROW 1: single bed with cream blanket and sage pillow; small bedside table; wardrobe with two simple doors; sage cushioned armchair.
ROW 2: small warm brick fireplace with cream mantel; bookcase with just a few colored book blocks; standing floor lamp with cream shade; wooden rocking chair with sage cushion.
ROW 3: simple round wooden stool; low coffee table; small wall clock with cream face (no numerals); rectangular dining table with one small cream vase.
ROW 4: plain wooden dining chair; cream refrigerator; low kitchen cupboard; small kitchen work table.
ROW 5: wicker basket drawn with broad simple bands; closed timber storage chest with cream latch; small shop display cabinet with three broad item blocks; wall shelf with two jars.
ROW 6: tall potted mint-green tree; small potted fern made of 4 broad leaves; oval cream rug with a plain sage border; square cream rug with a plain sage border.
Sprites must have clean simple silhouettes; preserve semantic identity; adult furniture fills about 22-28 logical pixels, small wall objects 12-18 px. Do not surround furniture with a tile frame or full scene. Genuine transparent alpha. Match calm light game palette, significantly simplify the currently intricate furniture samples.
portraits:
Use case: identity-preserve. ONE production dialogue portrait atlas for the four EXISTING animal villagers in the attached reference. Match their exact identities, fur markings, outfits and hats. Do not redesign into humans. The reference has FOUR ROWS: row1 shopkeeper, row2 gardener, row3 carpenter, row4 fisherman.
Output a transparent landscape sprite sheet EXACTLY 4 columns x 3 rows, 12 bust portraits in equal square cells. Each portrait is a 48x48 logical pixel drawing enlarged with nearest-neighbor square pixels. Cute simple pixel art, broad flat pastel colors, muted mauve/taupe outline, minimal facial pixels, no painterly gradients, no texture noise, no polished anime rendering, no text/labels, no card backgrounds. Three-quarter/front friendly bust composition from chest to ears/hat, consistent head size. Each character readable as the same tiny sprite in reference.
COLUMNS left-to-right:
1. shopkeeper: cream cat with a rust-orange tuft/patch on forehead and rust-brown merchant vest/apron with cream horizontal trim, NO hat.
2. gardener: cream cat wearing muted sage green wide-brim gardener hat with a small cream blossom on right side and sage overalls.
3. carpenter: cream/beige cat with rust-brown forehead tuft/patch, dusty slate-blue work shirt and simple warm brown apron/work belt, NO hat.
4. fisherman: slate-gray cat wearing warm ochre brimmed fishing hat, pale cream shirt and muted sage fishing vest.
ROWS top-to-bottom: neutral attentive expression; happy smiling expression; mildly concerned/thoughtful expression. Expression changes must be obvious but gentle, with same clothes, palette, crop and head position in every row. No new props or lettering. Transparent pixels outside busts; generous transparent gutters, do not crop ears/hats. Preserve all four character designs from reference.
tiles:
Use case: style-transfer. ONE practical seamless pixel TILE SET sheet for Pixel Farm, based on the attached existing grass atlas and the game's mint/pastel object palette. Current indoor flooring is rejected because each tiny tile has a thick dark frame, producing a distracting grid. Replace it with quiet larger horizontal boards. No copying outside game assets.
Output an OPAQUE landscape PNG, EXACTLY 4 columns x 2 rows of square tile swatches edge-to-edge, no gutters or frames between cells, no labels, no text, no scene, no perspective, no shadows, no baked checkerboard. Each cell represents one 16x16 logical pixel tile enlarged with nearest neighbor. Flat orthographic top-down tiles. Each tile independently wraps seamlessly in BOTH directions, including floor/plank seams; never draw a border around a tile.
ROW 1 left-right:
1. warm pale honey wood floor: just TWO broad horizontal boards per tile, very faint 1px seam, no knots or grain, at most 3 close colors, low contrast.
2. same honey wood floor alternate: same board heights and edges, one softly offset small seam, still low contrast.
3. cream wallpaper: almost solid warm cream, tiny sparse sage diamond/dot motif, VERY low contrast, no frame.
4. wooden lower wall: broad warm light timber panels and a single muted horizontal trim line, no dark boxes or dense grain.
ROW 2 left-right:
1. spring grass: soft yellow-green field matching the attached game's grass, sparse small pale green tufts, no outlined blades.
2. summer grass: same sparse texture and pattern scale, slightly deeper fresh green, still pastel.
3. autumn grass: same texture in pale golden straw and sage, two tiny dusty coral fallen leaf clusters, muted not orange neon.
4. winter snow: soft cream-blue near-white snow with a few very pale blue pixel flecks, no grass green remaining, no black outlines.
Max 3-4 closely related flat colors per tile. Hard square pixels, no blur/gradients, no high-detail surface texture. The floor especially must read as a calm background underneath furniture, with no visible grid of square frames when repeated.
